tab.behavior.section.window-position.hin: Saves each character's real EVE client window position, restored via the Move to Saved Positions hotkey or automatically on login. Set All copies the selected window's current position to every character; Clear All removes every saved position.
tab.behavior.title: behavior
tab.bounty.section.bounty-rate-overlay.h: Displays ISK bounty payouts per minute/hour on each thumbnail, calculated from EVE gamelogs. Requires chatlog monitoring to be enabled.
tab.bounty.title: bounty overlay
tab.characters.section.per-character-con: Add a character below, or use "Populate from Open Clients" to detect one automatically.
Customize each character's saved position, size, border color, display name, and jump-to hotkey. Characters are added automatically when detected.
tab.characters.title: characters
tab.chatlog.section.chatlog-monitoring.h: Watches EVE's chatlog and gamelog files to drive the DPS overlay, mining overlay, and system-location display. In EVE, enable
Esc > Chat Channel Settings > Log chat to file
so logs get written to disk.
tab.chatlog.section.log-directories.head: Log Directories
tab.chatlog.title: log monitoring
tab.combat.section.alerts.heading: Alerts
tab.combat.section.alerts.hint: Notifications and status icon triggered by incoming damage. Requires Text Overlays above to be enabled.
tab.combat.section.combat-dps-overlay.hi: Displays incoming and outgoing DPS below each thumbnail, calculated from EVE gamelogs. Requires chatlog monitoring to be enabled.
tab.combat.section.taking-damage-alert.h: Notifies on incoming hits. Repeat rate, border color/duration are set on the Notifications tab under "Taking Damage". Requires notifications enabled.
tab.combat.title: combat overlay
tab.general.section.system-configuration: Log Level sets logging verbosity and applies globally, across all profiles. Scan Interval is the delay between checks for new windows, and applies to this profile only.
tab.general.section.window-filters.hint: Configure which applications to track. Each filter can match by window class name and executable name.
tab.general.title: general
tab.hotkeys.section.app-hotkeys.heading: App Hotkeys
tab.hotkeys.section.app-hotkeys.hint: Bind a hotkey to jump straight to a specific running application (e.g. your browser or Discord), picked from a list of open windows.
tab.hotkeys.section.client-cycling.hint: Cycle through EVE client windows across every profile, regardless of hotkey groups.
tab.hotkeys.section.cycle-all-clients.hi: Bind hotkeys to cycle through every logged-in EVE client, ordered by the Characters list (any not yet added there follow after, in detection order), regardless of which profile is loaded or how hotkey groups are defined.
Bind hotkeys to cycle through EVE client windows still sitting at the login screen.
tab.hotkeys.section.desktop-apps.heading: External App Hotkeys
tab.hotkeys.section.desktop-apps.hint: Jump to things outside EVE: the last app you had focused, a specific running application, or a URL in your browser.
tab.hotkeys.section.exclusion-cycling.hi: Bind hotkeys to cycle through excluded characters, or toggle exclusion for the currently focused one.
tab.hotkeys.section.hotkey-groups.hint: Groups of characters you can cycle through with hotkeys, each with forward and optional backward keys.
tab.hotkeys.section.hotkey-system.hint: Controls how the hotkeys configured below are registered and triggered.
tab.hotkeys.section.key-bindings.heading: Local Hotkeys

tab.hotkeys.section.notification-cycling: Jump between characters that recently sent a notification, most recent first. Press repeatedly to keep stepping through the queue.
tab.hotkeys.section.profile-hotkeys.head: Profile Hotkeys
tab.hotkeys.section.profile-hotkeys.hint: Bind hotkeys to jump to a specific profile or cycle through all profiles. Stays active regardless of which profile is loaded.
tab.hotkeys.section.quick-groups.heading: Quick Groups
tab.hotkeys.section.quick-groups.hint: Hover a thumbnail and press a group's assign key to toggle it in or out — membership is temporary and resets on restart.
tab.hotkeys.section.system.heading: System
tab.hotkeys.section.system.hint: Suspends or resumes all hotkeys. This hotkey always works, even while others are suspended.
tab.hotkeys.section.url-hotkeys.heading: URL Hotkeys
tab.hotkeys.section.url-hotkeys.hint: Bind a hotkey to open a URL in your default browser.
tab.hotkeys.section.window-actions.hint: Bind hotkeys for quick window actions — minimize, close, hide thumbnails, or toggle auto-minimize.
tab.hotkeys.section.window-focus.heading: Window Focus
